text: Only demo/demo-pass can sign in. Invalid credentials return 401. Protected cart and order endpoints require a session. Sign out invalidates it.
GET /api/products supports case-insensitive q search and category filtering. Products contain integer prices in cents and stock.
POST /api/cart accepts productId and integer quantity 1..20. Unknown products return 404, insufficient stock returns 409, invalid quantities return 422. Carts are isolated per session.

POST /api/orders requires name (2..80 characters), address (5..200 characters), and Idempotency-Key (8..100 alphanumeric/hyphen characters). Empty carts return 422. Valid checkout returns 201, clears cart, and preserves authoritative catalog prices.

Repeating the same idempotency key with the same shipping payload returns the existing order (200). Reusing it with a different payload returns 409. Concurrent identical requests create exactly one order.
Mutations require a session-bound X-CSRF-Token. Cross-origin mutations are rejected with 403. Session cookies are HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict. Another session cannot read an order (404).

The shopping journey supports keyboard operation and 390px mobile screens. Sold-out items cannot be added. Search empty states, checkout errors, and confirmation are announced. Cart survives page reload.
